dimensions.selection: Android qualifier/source-set precedence not resolved for a device. Missing entries are explicit; do not treat sw600dp as expanded width breakpoint.
dimensions.unit: dp (logical density-independent units, not device pixels)

exact_parity_not_established: Numeric expanded lower bound requires dependency definition with provenance
Android resource/locale/source-set resolution and Moko/Android runtime text escapes/formatting
Material3 expressive widget shapes, typography, interaction states and motion tokens
OS/wallpaper-dependent dynamic colors and system dark-mode preference behavior
IME, autofill, accessibility, focus/scroll/insets and password reveal animations
Vector rasterization, density/font scaling and device-pixel/screenshot equivalence
WebView/browser navigation, session/network outcomes and runtime exception displayString()

actions.guest: active signInJob guard then launchIO { sessionController.enterGuest() }

failure_dialog.cancellation: CancellationException rethrown; failure dialog not shown
message_parts: it.displayString() (runtime exception display; not fixed translation)

interactions.validation_note: No trim/whitespace rejection; username error returns before password check. Error reset only on next submit reaching that field, not on edit.

validation_steps.on_empty: showUsernameError = true; return; password state untouched

validation_steps.action: focusManager.clearFocus(); isProgressIndicatorVisible = true; launchIO sign-in job

expanded.axis: window width dp; not orientation, height, or smallest-width resource qualifier
expanded.non_expanded_branch: !windowSizeClass.isExpanded (includes both compact and medium AndroidX classes)
expanded.unresolved: WIDTH_DP_EXPANDED_LOWER_BOUND belongs to androidx.window.core.layout.WindowSizeClass; numeric definition absent from canonical source. Resolve current dependency with separate provenance before implementing Rust breakpoint.

fields.error_bottom_padding: normal 16dp padding omitted when respective error shown; supportingText rendered instead
fields.width_operator: Modifier.width (preferred width subject to parent constraints)

shared.progress_overlay: CircularWavyProgressIndicator at Box center when isProgressIndicatorVisible

license.notice: Original XML copyright/license notice retained byte-for-byte; no artwork conversion

logo.variant_selection: Canonical main drawable exported; listed variant/source-set overrides require explicit Android resource selection if present

provenance.head_policy: Reference revision is historical; live Git HEAD is reported by CLI only, never embedded in deterministic artifacts
provenance.source_state: working_tree_bytes (existing user edits included; not claimed clean HEAD tree)

scope: Canonical working-tree SignIn presentation/interaction source baseline; not a Kotlin runtime bridge or renderer redesign

strings.encoding: UTF-8; xml_inner_raw/xml_element_raw preserve XML entities, backslashes, markup and format markers. xml_text only decodes XML, not Android/Moko escapes or formatting.
strings.fallback: Missing local definitions have explicit base_fallback_candidate; generated Android/Moko locale selection and escaping are not verified here. Ambiguous definitions have no chosen value.
